{{Quote|How many did we lose ''this'' time?''"<br />"''Only ''Skud,'' Jabba.|Mosep Bineed (impersonating Jabba the Hutt) and his minion|<ref name="MSW28" />}}
'''Skud's species''' were a race of red-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. They had a frill of spines atop their heads, and what appeared to be naturally armored bodies. Their armor was not strong enough to stop a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster bolt]], however, as [[Skud]] learned at his peril when he was killed in a fight with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] on [[Orleon]].<ref name="MSW28" />
